instruction: Hold the cabinet still with the left arm and pull the drawer open with the right arm; then let go with both arms and move away.

outcome.real_measurement: Open: drawer joint position >= 8 cm (of 12 cm) at every judged step. Real world: tracked handle position relative to the cabinet.
Cabinet in place: the cabinet origin within 1 cm (horizontally) of where it stood at the start, at every judged step. Real world: tracked cabinet pose.
Stabilised (process): the cabinet never moved more than 1.5 cm from its start during the episode (a dragged-and-pushed-back cabinet fails). Real world: tracked cabinet pose.
Standing on the table: the cabinet body's lowest corner within 5 mm of the table.
Upright: the cabinet's z axis within 5 deg of vertical.

Commanded vs actual opening (v3.2, E24c fix 3): for every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of a judged object, measured opening minus the free-space opening of its current gripper command <= 5 mm at every judged step (a gripper still closing on, or propped open by, something fails). Real world: gripper encoder vs command.

Consequence test after the judged window (protocol v3.1/v3.2): every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of the drawer handle or the cabinet knob retracts its TCP 3 cm along its approach axis in 0.5 s with its last gripper command unchanged, then holds 0.5 s; the drawer handle or the cabinet knob must move <= 1 cm. Real world: same motion, tracked pose.
Settled: the fastest bounding-box corner of every judged object moves <= 2 cm/s at every judged step, speed from positions (v3.2, E24c fix 1). Real world: frame differencing of the tracked pose.
Stays put: the handle centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.
Stays put: the knob centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.

source.protocol: v3 (veritask, unchanged) + imsim v3.2 signals (imsim/imsim/verify/v32.py): position-based speeds, all-link enclosure, retreat aftermath, commanded vs actual opening, 5 s settle cap
source.released_code_predicate: env info['success']: drawer joint position >= 8 cm at the evaluated step (no release, no settle, no check that the cabinet stayed in place)

notes: Objects: handle = the drawer link's handle box, knob = the cabinet link's side-knob box (their contact pairs cover the whole drawer / cabinet link). Release over both links (contact + all-link enclosure of the handle / knob boxes); retreat over both; quiescence over both.
